p: Shinar: That is, of Babylon: by kings here, meaning, them that were governors of cities.
nations: Of a people gathered from various countries.
joined together in the vale of: Ambition is the chief cause of wars among princes.
salt sea: Called also the dead sea, or the lake Asphaltite, near Sodom and Gomorrah.
vale of Siddim was full of: And afterward was overwhelmed with water, and so was called the salt sea.
took Lot: The godly are plagued many times with the wicked: therefore their company is dangerous.
confederate with Abram: God removed them to join Abram, and preserves him from their idolatry and superstitions.
brought forth bread and wine: For Abram and his soldiers refreshment, not to offer sacrifice.
blessed him: Melchizedek fed Abram, declared himself to represent a king, and he blessed him as the high priest.
Save only that which the young: He did not want his liberality to be hurtful to others.
